ma.f: (astronomy, usually in the plural) Abbreviation of milli-arcsecond.

s.g: (colloquial, and in direct address) mother, mama

ma.f: (Chinese Malaysian and Singaporean) Alternative spelling of mah.

s.g: (informal, in direct address) Mother, mom, mama.
A form of address for a woman: contraction of madam.
A polite and formal way to address a woman.
s.x: Ma'am, will you be attending the dinner this evening?

s.g: A respectful term of address to a woman of higher rank or position.
s.x:
– Sergeant, have the platoon in formation and ready for inspection at 0800.
– Aye aye, ma'am.

s.g: (archaic) A title for a married woman.
s.x: That is Ma'am Smith, the matriarch of the Smith families.

s.g: (archaic, US, education) A female schoolteacher; a schoolmarm.
